interface.longDescription: FB-Lane Coordination packages Codex skills and an MCP server for lane-based project work. Codex supplies native concurrency; FB-Lane supplies the shared board, file claims, handoff docs, and Product/Captain integration gate so multiple lane instructions can run at the same time without overwriting each other.
